seo.title: How 29 Air Force planes finally sank the Tirpitz with Tallboy bombs
seo.description:
After ten failed attacks, 29 Royal Air Force aircraft used 12,030‑pound Tallboy bombs to sink the battleship Tirpitz near Tromsø. The strike capsized the ship, killing 940 of its crew.

#Tirpitz #TallboyBomb #WWIIHistory #AirForce #NavalWarfare

Sources:
- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Operation_Catechism
- https://web.archive.org/web/20120323063336/http:/www.raf.mod.uk/history/bombercommandtirpitznovember121944.cfm
- https://bombercommandmuseumarchives.ca/tirpitz.html
